shooting.title: From research to practice: Optimising shooting performance in elite biathlon
shooting.reason: The article page shows the abstract and a cover image; no full text or PDF link is exposed (there is a Subscribe link). Full text, including the ten recommendations, still unread.
shooting.abstractGist: Interviews with five experienced international coaches on technique, periodising shooting training, range approach and venue preparation. Themes: individualise; keep the core technique constant while adapting breathing to intensity; treat the range approach as a skill of its own.
